artifact_reasoning: Significant structural artifacts are present, primarily the fusion/melting of the central figure's hands into the fish's body (Severity 3.0). Additionally, the water surface exhibits smudging and inconsistent reflections (Severity 2.5), and the boat geometry shows slight warping (Severity 1.5). These defects indicate the image is AI-generated and lacks perfect physical coherence, lowering the artifact score substantially below 5.0.
